scripts.dev: node -e "const {spawn}=require('node:child_process'); const cmds=[['npm',['run','dev:server']],['npm',['run','dev:web']]]; const ps=cmds.map(([cmd,args])=>spawn(cmd,args,{stdio:'inherit',shell:true})); const stop=()=>ps.forEach(p=>p.kill()); process.on('SIGINT',()=>{stop(); process.exit(130)}); process.on('SIGTERM',()=>{stop(); process.exit(143)}); ps.forEach(p=>p.on('exit',code=>{if(code){stop(); process.exit(code)}}));"
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:server && npm run build:web && npm run desktop:prepare-native && npm --workspace apps/desktop run dev
scripts.desktop:pack:fast: npm run build:server && npm run build:web && npm --workspace apps/desktop run pack:fast
scripts.desktop:pack:full: npm run build:server && npm run build:web && npm run desktop:prepare-native && npm --workspace apps/desktop run pack:full
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.test:build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.test:regression: node apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-node-native.cjs && npm run test:build && npm --workspace apps/desktop run prepare-runtime && npm run test:server && npm run test:web && npm run test:desktop
